name: Dead Bug
summary: On the back with legs in tabletop and arms to the ceiling, one leg and the opposite arm reach away and return while the trunk stays still. No head lift, so it suits most people.
steps: Lie on the back, legs in tabletop, arms straight up over the shoulders.
Breathe out to reach one leg long and the opposite arm back by the ear.
Breathe in to return; change sides.

layers.title: Toe taps
layers.text: Bent knee lowers to tap the toe.

layers.title: Add a prop
layers.text: Press a ball between the still knee and hand.

modifications: Keep the knee bent as the leg lowers.

cautions.note: Usually well tolerated; keep the range small.

cues:
The back of the ribs stays heavy on the mat.
Only go as low as the lower back stays quiet.
Move slowly enough that nothing wobbles.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
